findings.title: Remove the stray `-E` backup test file
findings.description: The diff adds `packages/core/tests/services/CoreServiceFactory.test.ts-E:1-146`, an editor-style duplicate of `packages/core/tests/services/CoreServiceFactory.test.ts`. It still calls `createContextPipeline(FIXTURE_PROJECT_PATH)` and `createContextPipeline(checkout)` at `packages/core/tests/services/CoreServiceFactory.test.ts-E:29,35,59,99,119,141` without the now-required `{ adoptionStateWrites }` options object. The Vitest include pattern at `packages/core/vitest.config.ts:5` does not match `.ts-E`, so this is dead duplicate code that would fail if renamed or picked up by tooling; remove it.

findings.title: `context_build` advertises idempotence while first brownfield build mutates state
findings.description: `packages/mcp-server/src/tools/contextTools.ts:155` still declares `idempotentHint: true`, but the `context_build` handler passes `'persist'` at `packages/mcp-server/src/tools/contextTools.ts:202-204`. On a first brownfield detection, `packages/core/src/adoption/adoptionResolver.ts:128-129` writes `adoption.state = in_progress`, and `packages/core/src/adoption/adoptionFacts.ts:92` adds the one-time state-set notice; the next identical call sees `in_progress` and emits different Adoption Facts. This breaks the idempotence contract both by mutating `.context-forge.toml` and by changing output on repeated calls; set `idempotentHint` to false or separate the state-writing operation.

findings.title: `template_preview` is still not side-effect free
findings.description: `packages/mcp-server/src/tools/contextTools.ts:228` advertises `readOnlyHint: true`, and the tool description at `packages/mcp-server/src/tools/contextTools.ts:225-227` says it triggers no side effects. The new `'read-only'` pipeline option at `packages/mcp-server/src/tools/contextTools.ts:267-270` only prevents adoption-state writes; `generateContext` still calls `ensureGuideForProject` at `packages/mcp-server/src/tools/contextTools.ts:92`, whose `GuideManager.ensureCheckout` `not_initialized` branch at `packages/core/src/guides/GuideManager.ts:211-214` can initialize a guide submodule and mutate the checkout. The added test at `packages/mcp-server/tests/contextTools.test.ts:368-378` checks only the pipeline option, not the tool’s full read-only contract; either remove auto-init for previews or change the annotation/description.

findings.title: New wiring expands positional APIs instead of named options
findings.description: `packages/core/src/services/ContextIntegrator.ts:86-94` now has seven positional constructor parameters, and `generateContext` at `packages/mcp-server/src/tools/contextTools.ts:58-63` has five. The TypeScript rules prefer named parameters for functions taking three or more arguments; the seven-argument call at `packages/core/src/services/CoreServiceFactory.ts:43-51` and the null-heavy test construction at `packages/core/tests/services/ContextIntegrator.test.ts:384` show how easy this is to misorder. Use options objects such as `{ engine, enableNewEngine, resolvers }` and `{ projectId, adoptionStateWrites, overrides, additionalInstructions, worktreeId }` to make the new wiring self-documenting.

findings.title: Centralize the new mode and state comparison values
findings.description: `packages/core/src/adoption/adoptionResolver.ts:26` defines `AdoptionStateWrites` as raw string literals and line 128 compares against `'persist'`; callers repeat `'persist'`/`'read-only'` at `packages/cli/src/commands/build.ts:84` and `packages/mcp-server/src/tools/contextTools.ts:204,270`. Adoption state values are also scattered through `packages/core/src/adoption/adoptionOutcome.ts#decideOutcome`, `packages/core/src/adoption/adoptionResolver.ts:91,107,128-129`, and `packages/core/src/adoption/adoptionFacts.ts:92`, even though `ADOPTION_STATES` exists at `packages/core/src/config/ConfigKeys.ts:27`. AGENTS.md says comparison values must be defined once, and the TypeScript guide prefers `as const` objects; define named constants or a const object and use them in conditionals, call sites, and tests.

findings.title: New section key breaks existing kebab-case naming
findings.description: `packages/core/src/services/ContextTemplateEngine.ts:113-119` adds `key: 'adoptionFacts'`, while the surrounding section identifiers in the same `buildTemplate` method use kebab-case or single words (`project-intro`, `project-info`, `context-init`, `permissiveness`, `additional-notes`, `current-events`, `tools-section`). Rename the key to `adoption-facts` so section identifiers remain consistent and future tooling can rely on one naming shape.

findings.title: Integration runner injects the entire environment into the CLI process
findings.description: `packages/cli/tests/integration/build.integration.test.ts:96` runs the built CLI with `env: { ...process.env, CONTEXT_FORGE_DATA_DIR: dataDir }`. The testing rules say never inject a whole `.env`/all environment variables into a test process and instead pass an explicit named list; similar spreads appear at `packages/mcp-server/tests/serverLifecycle.test.ts:98` and `packages/cli/tests/integration/guidesVersionFlag.integration.test.ts:33`. Use an explicit allowlist such as `PATH`, `HOME`, `CONTEXT_FORGE_DATA_DIR`, and any required `CF_*` flags so credentials present in the parent process are not handed to spawned commands.
